title: SI No 78 of 2014 - Notice made by the Minister of H&SD Bringing the Status of Children Act, 2014 into Force
text:
VIRGIN ISLANDS
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT 2014 NO. 78
STATUS OF CHILDREN ACT, 2014
(NO. 6 OF 2014)
NOTICE MADE BY THE MINISTER FOR HEALTH AND SOCIAL
DEVELOPMENT UNDER SECTION 1 OF THE STATUS OF CHILDREN
ACT, 2014 DECLARING THE DATE ON WHICH THE SAID ACT
SHALL COME INTO FORCE
[Gazetted 30th October, 2014]
WHEREAS section 1 of the Status of Children Act, 2014 (No. 6 of 2014)
provides that the said Act shall come into force on such date as the Minister may, by
Notice published in the Gazette, appoint;
NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers vested in me, I hereby
appoint the 31st day of October, 2014 to be the date on which the Status of Children Act,
2014 shall come into force.
Made by the Minister for Health and Social Development this 27th day of October, 2014.
(Sgd.) Ronnie W. Skelton,
Minister for Health and Social Development.
